notes: Canon VB series (VB-H41, VB-H610VE, VB-H710F, VB-S800D, VB-S900F, VB-M series, etc.) all use /rtpstream/config<N>=r|u|m where N=1..5 (five independently configurable RTP streams). The =r|u|m transport hint is optional; r=TCP, u=UDP, m=multicast. config1 is the first/main stream; config2 is typically the sub/secondary stream. Port default is 554 (configurable to 1024–65535). RTSP authentication method (Basic/Digest/None) is configurable per camera. Does NOT use /stream/profile<N> paths — those appear only in community/third-party docs and are unconfirmed against official Canon manuals.
